profile_text.body:
Cerence Inc. is a public company headquartered in Burlington, Massachusetts, traded under the ticker CRNC, with SEC CIK 0001768267. Its website describes it as delivering conversational and agentic AI-powered user experiences for automotive and beyond, and says its work is powered by CaLLM, a family of language models it describes as advanced. The company says it provides tailor-made AI solutions that integrate with vehicle brands, and that it is moving to advance generative AI and large language model innovation for automotive and transportation user experiences.

Among the products described on the site is Cerence Emergency Vehicle Detection, or EVD, which the company says is already deployed in production vehicles. According to the site, EVD detects and localizes more than 1,500 emergency sirens across nearly 50 countries, identifying approaching emergency vehicles from more than 300 meters away using interior microphones and beyond 800 meters when paired with exterior microphones. The site also describes dynamic speech enhancement for multi-seat in-car environments, work with Microsoft on Zero Trust and layered AI security for in-car assistants, and a Q&A on North American OEMs moving toward embedded in-car AI platforms. It names Timo Matheja and Stefan Hamerich in connection with a speech signal enhancement demonstration. A third quarter results item on the site reports revenue up 12% YoY, connected services revenue up 20% YoY, and operating cash flow of $20M supporting a first-ever share repurchase program.

The company's record lists no lawsuits. Its law exposure is recorded in Massachusetts, with a count of 191.
